title: Banana Milk Paletas
changes_from_base: Ripe banana blended with milk and vanilla replaces the strawberry purée and jam.
summary: Simple, creamy ice pops made from ripe banana blended with milk and vanilla.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Peel the 2 bananas and break them into a blender.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Add 240 ml whole milk, 1 tsp vanilla and 50 g caster sugar and blend until smooth.

steps.title: Pour
steps.text: Pour into five 90 ml moulds and add the sticks.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Freeze until solid, at least 6 h.

steps.title: Release
steps.text: Run cold water over the outside of the moulds and ease the pops out by the sticks.

tips: Use really ripe, speckled bananas for the sweetest flavour.
Blend thoroughly so there are no lumps of banana left in the mixture.
Run water over the outside of the mould only, not the opening, so the pops don't melt before serving.
storage: Keep the pops in their moulds or wrapped individually in the freezer.
